from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its case type and charges."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title")
    is_criminal_case: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this is a criminal case")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="General case category: 刑事, 民事, 行政")
    charges: list[str] = Field(description="The criminal charges cited, if any")
    charge_category: str | None = Field(description="The criminal law chapter/category these charges fall under")
    matches_target_category: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the charges fall under '侵犯公民人身权利、民主权利罪'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
